description: This Java class implements a servlet filter in the OpenMRS project. It sets the thread's context class loader to the OpenMRS class loader so that JSPs can access module-defined Expression Language functions.

classes.name: JspClassLoaderFilter
classes.description: A servlet filter that sets the OpenMRS class loader as the context class loader for the current thread to enable JSP EL functions.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the filter. Currently does nothing.

methods.name: doFilter
methods.description: Sets the thread's context class loader to the OpenMRS class loader, then continues with the filter chain.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Performs cleanup when the filter is destroyed. Currently does nothing.
